findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a worker handles a settings fix whose Done when names forge.toml.
The refusal proof uses a readme fix, which exercises only the restricted case. In src/forge/githooks.py:133, worker commits are permitted when task.settings_allowed succeeds; src/forge/task.py:212 grants that permission whenever Done when contains `forge.toml`. Native handback has the same exception at src/forge/native.py:255. Consequently, workers can change sample_data in the dedicated settings fixes used by this flow, despite Done-when 2 requiring that they cannot. Enforce the restriction on that path and extend the command-level proof.

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 2
The `not match["task"]` condition excludes story workers from sample mode. After sign-off, sample mode explicitly continues until the settings fix disables it, so a story started during that interval receives instructions to add automated tests and run `forge test`; continued rounds also receive the CI-required paragraph. Meanwhile, configuration still disables those tests and checks. Apply the sample-proof selection to tasks as well as fixes; the current proof exercises fixes only.

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 2
Forcing test_place to local also activates fullrun.notices, called by `forge next` at src/forge/nextstep.py:152. With GitHub available and no recent full-suite status—the normal sample-prototype state—src/forge/fullrun.py:161 tells the coordinator to run `forge test --full`. That command then fails at fullrun.py:74 because this same configuration clears the test command. The reminder repeats while sample mode remains enabled.
Adds work: suppress full-run reminders in sample mode; F 3 x H 2 = 6; 2 x C = 2

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 3, Harm 2
The new personal-data exemption applies to plan approval only. Sign-off still rejects open brief answers and client questions at src/forge/records.py:337–355, requires a manually matching Answers quote at lines 327–336, and validates customer format, reply method and demo address at lines 306–313. Thus the remaining Done-when 4 clauses are not delivered here. The Tasks table assigns those changes and their command-level proof to SIGNOFF, so this is deferred advice rather than a blocking SETUP omission.
